evals.prompt: with-cite: Briefly explain whether GitHub Actions can authenticate to AWS without storing long-lived AWS credentials.
evals.expected_output: Every externally verifiable claim has an inline footnote whose direct source link and exact quote support that claim; primary GitHub or AWS documentation is preferred.
expectations: Every externally verifiable factual claim has an inline footnote marker.
Every footnote contains a direct URL and an exact supporting quote.
The answer prefers primary GitHub or AWS documentation.

evals.prompt: with-cite: Prove that every healthy adult must drink exactly eight glasses of water every day.
evals.expected_output: The answer rejects or qualifies the premise when exact evidence is unavailable and supports factual corrections with claim-level footnotes and exact quotations.
expectations: The answer rejects or qualifies the universal eight-glasses premise.
Every externally verifiable factual correction has an inline footnote marker.
Every footnote contains a direct URL and an exact supporting quote.

evals.prompt: with-cite: Is it accurate to say React 19 makes useMemo obsolete and automatically optimizes every component? Keep the answer short.
evals.expected_output: The answer distinguishes supported facts from inference or overstatement, avoids claiming more than official React sources support, and provides exact quoted evidence in linked footnotes.
expectations: The answer does not present useMemo as universally obsolete or every component as automatically optimized.
Every externally verifiable factual claim has an inline footnote marker.
Every footnote contains a direct URL and an exact supporting quote from an official React source.
